ghosts.name: Spirit

descriptionTranslations.de: Grundlegender Geist ohne besondere Stärken.
descriptionTranslations.es: Fantasma base sin fortalezas importantes.

ghosts.name: Wraith

ghosts.name: Banshee

ghosts.name: Shade

ghosts.name: Yurei

behaviors.label: Temporarily disappears from photos and video footage when captured on camera.
Locks onto a single player for the entire investigation and cannot kill anyone else during a hunt.
Can instantly turn a light back off moments after a player switches it on.
Can close a door smoothly and silently, without the usual creak or slam.
Can teleport next to a random player between hunts, sometimes leaving a stray EMF reading behind.
Sometimes leaves no UV fingerprint at all on a surface it touches.
Temporarily copies another ghost type's hunting speed and abilities.
Settles into one of two fixed hunting speeds at random each hunt, rather than a single consistent speed.
Disrupts electronics and reveals a player's heartbeat from farther away than a normal ghost.
Occasionally drains extra sanity from a nearby player while the fuse box is switched on.
Becomes more active, not less, when players are nearby.
Produces paranormal sounds more frequently than a typical ghost.
Rarely wanders far from its own room and never changes its favorite room.
Starts hunts at a high, fixed speed that does not accelerate further from sustained line of sight.
Permanently slows down the more items are moved or interacted with during the investigation, eventually crawling at a fraction of its starting speed.
Less likely than a typical ghost to interact with doors or light switches.
Reaches full hunting speed from line of sight much faster than a typical ghost.
Cannot kill a player sheltering inside an official hiding spot -- the hunt simply ends instead.
Hunts almost blind, relying on footstep sound rather than line of sight to find players.
Can detect a sprinting player from much farther away than a typical ghost detects footsteps.
Hunts at a higher sanity threshold if it detects a player sprinting nearby before the hunt begins.
